decisions.what: Unattended run: orchestrator answered all 33 requirements open questions as delegate (requirements-answers.md)
decisions.why: Brief DECISION POLICY forbids clarifying questions; no mains/battery/motor/>30V/RF flags apply, so no safety unknown is being guessed
Brief demands an uncut GND plane directly under the switching components plus 2.05 W natural-convection cooling on <=50x40mm; 2L cannot give both the image plane and the bottom thermal copper

decisions.what: Add a 4A slow-blow input fuse (DCR <=30 mOhm) beyond the brief's protection list
decisions.why: IC OCP+hiccup cannot protect against a shorted high-side switch; upstream supply current limit is unstated, so the fuse is what bounds fault energy on-board
Below the AM broadcast band, keeps 18V-input min-on-time and switching loss comfortable, and allows 20-40% ripple with a stocked inductor

decisions.what: Spawn tier deviation: Fable 5 unavailable (out of credits); judgment roles run on Opus instead
decisions.why: Playbook forbids silent downgrade - Opus is the nearest available tier for architect/placement/reviewer roles; recorded rather than hidden

decisions.what: Input fuse: take the 5A slow-blow (Bel 0685T5000-01, 5032 pcs) over the spec-ideal 4A sibling (174 pcs)
decisions.why: Requirements Q24 binds stock >=2000 pcs and the brief says an out-of-stock part is a failed design; 5A still opens on a bolted fault and costs only 119 mW at the 2.44 A worst case

decisions.what: P3 must pull screw-terminal body height, pin diameter and recommended hole size from the vendor datasheet - LCSC attributes do not carry them
decisions.why: Footprint cannot be built or DFM-checked on missing mechanical data; flagged by the protection scout as its open item

decisions.what: All MLCCs must be X7R (no X5R anywhere); Cout bank moves to 22uF/25V 1210 X7R
decisions.why: Architect computed 83-87 C board surface; X5R is rated 85 C so it is a latent failure, and the X7R part also derates less on DC bias (~12% vs ~25%)

decisions.what: Add a 15V Zener + gate resistor clamp on the reverse-polarity P-FET gate
decisions.why: AO4407A survives 18V static on its +/-25V Vgs, but the architect's 25.4V hot-plug ring on the screw terminals exceeds it; the clamp is the cheap fix

decisions.what: In1 and In2 both solid GND; no power net may use an inner layer
decisions.why: 0.5oz inner copper needs 3.0-4.6mm widths for these currents per IPC-2152, which is unroutable - so power stays on 1oz outer and the inners are pure return/thermal

decisions.what: Feedback divider uses 0.1% resistors regardless of IC choice
decisions.why: Reference tolerance alone spans -1.2%/+1.8% across the candidates and already eats 60-95% of the +/-2% budget; FB bias current error is negligible (<=0.1%) so the divider tolerance is the only lever left

decisions.what: RC snubber values come from general practice, not a vendor citation - footprint sized generously and left DNP
decisions.why: None of the three candidate vendors publishes a snubber value; the brief wants the footprint anyway, so honest sourcing is to mark it uncited rather than invent a citation

decisions.what: P2 may revisit the 4.0A current-limit-minimum floor - it was a delegate tightening (Q5), not a user requirement
decisions.why: It is the single rule disqualifying LMR33630 (3.85A min, ~3.375A guaranteed Iout = 12.5% over the 3.0A load), and the AP64350 that satisfies it carries a 7-10mA UVLO penalty and external compensation

decisions.what: OVERRIDE of delegate answer Q14: UVLO retargeted from 6.5V/6.0V to 6.2V/5.3V
decisions.why: 0.5V hysteresis is less than this board's own 0.49V cable drop at 2.44A (motorboating), and VON=6.5V at the max threshold corner lands ~7.0V so the converter could refuse to start at its minimum rated input; also drops the UVLO divider draw from 81-181mW to 1-2mW
Decided on MAX Rds(on) 75/45 mOhm vs LMR33630's TYPICAL 95/66; TI's own max column gives 1.65W conduction -> Tj ~112C, over the 105C limit. SY8205 rejected on preliminary datasheet with typ-only Rds

decisions.what: 1 oz outer copper; both vendor reference layouts (2 oz) lose
decisions.why: JLC's only 4L/1.6mm 2oz-outer lamination has a 0.4284mm L1-L2 prepreg vs 1080B's 0.2444mm - nearly doubles thermal-via resistance and pushes the image plane 75% further from the hot loop; net +0.8C, so 2oz is worse here

decisions.what: Stackup JLC04161H-1080B; F.Cu + In1 + In2 + B.Cu ALL GND
decisions.why: JLC inner copper is 0.0152mm - thinner than the nominal 0.5oz the rule assumed - so inner power widths would need 3.5-5.3mm; declared explicitly because the pipeline default would otherwise pour In2 as +5V

decisions.what: Single flat root sheet (refdes 1-99, #PWR 100), 33 placed parts
decisions.why: Small board; hierarchy rejected to eliminate the /<sheet>/<LABEL> net-name mismatch class the recipe warns about
